stories.title: Decenas de miles de personas se manifiestan por la vivienda en Madrid en medio de la incertidumbre electoral

en.title: Tens of thousands demonstrate for housing in Madrid amid electoral uncertainty
en.summary: A large housing protest took place in Madrid, the second major march in a week. Demonstrators distributed blame among the progressive government and right-wing parties while pledging to continue their campaign regardless of who governs.

stories.title: Illa alerta de la llegada de un “mini-huracán mediterráneo” y anuncia “medidas importantes” de prevención en Cataluña

en.title: Illa alerts to arrival of a "Mediterranean mini-hurricane" and announces "important preventive measures" in Catalonia
en.summary: Catalan authorities issued alerts for torrential rains affecting Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona coastal areas. The regional government restricted mobility and activities in 20 counties starting Saturday evening as a precaution.

stories.title: Un clamor por la vivienda saca a decenas de miles de manifestantes en España y exige una huelga general: "No va de ideología, sino de decencia"

en.title: Housing crisis draws tens of thousands of protesters across Spain and calls for general strike: "It's not about ideology, but decency"
en.summary: Large-scale housing protests occurred across Spain, with demonstrators calling for a general strike. Most marches were peaceful, though disturbances occurred in Valencia; Catalonian protests were suspended due to severe weather.

stories.title: Nueve policías heridos y cinco detenidos tras los disturbios

en.title: Nine police officers wounded and five arrested following disturbances
en.summary: Approximately 6,000 people participated in a housing rights demonstration in Valencia that ended in tensions at a real estate investor event. Police faced disruptions when protesters attempted to access the venue, resulting in injuries and arrests.

stories.title: Cataluña envía un es-alert para restringir la movilidad en 20 comarcas ante la amenaza de un «temporal excepcional»

en.title: Catalonia sends es-alert to restrict mobility in 20 regions due to threat of exceptional storm
en.summary: Civil Protection authorities have issued an emergency alert restricting non-essential travel across 20 Catalan regions from Saturday evening to Sunday afternoon in response to an exceptional weather system affecting nearly all of Catalonia.

stories.title: Emiratos Árabes afirma que el copiloto del vuelo a Israel planeaba un «acto terrorista» y usó el hacha de emergencia del avión

en.title: United Arab Emirates says Flydubai co-pilot planned "terrorist act" and attacked captain with emergency axe
en.summary: Investigators in the United Arab Emirates confirmed that a Flydubai co-pilot heading to Israel planned a terrorist act and attacked the captain using an emergency aircraft axe, though authorities did not specify the motive for the assault.

stories.title: Máxima alerta ante la posibilidad de un minihuracán mediterráneo en el litoral de Catalunya

en.title: Maximum alert due to possibility of Mediterranean mini-hurricane on Catalan coast
en.summary: Civil Protection issued an emergency alert warning of torrential rainfall reaching the coastal and near-coastal areas of Tarragona, Barcelona, Girona, Osona, and Moianès.

stories.title: Garamendi ve “ilegal” una huelga general por la vivienda porque no es un conflicto laboral

en.title: Garamendi views general strike over housing as "illegal" because it is not a labor conflict
en.summary: A union leader has stated that a proposed general strike regarding housing issues would be illegal since the dispute does not constitute a labor matter, indicating potential court action if such a strike proceeds.

stories.title: La manifestación por la vivienda en Madrid llama a una huelga general

en.title: Madrid housing protest calls for general strike
en.summary: A housing protest in Madrid drew between 430,000 and 500,000 attendees according to different sources, with organizers calling for a general strike.

stories.title: Al menos 11 heridos por el derrumbe de un bar en San Vicente de la Sonsierra (La Rioja)

en.title: At least 11 injured in bar collapse in San Vicente de la Sonsierra (La Rioja)
en.summary: A bar collapsed early morning in La Rioja, injuring at least 12 people, with about 50 patrons inside at the time. Eight injured required hospital transport, with the floor collapsing first followed by the ceiling.

stories.title: Masivas manifestaciones por la vivienda en varias ciudades llaman a una huelga general

en.title: Large housing protests in several cities call for general strike
en.summary: Major demonstrations against the housing crisis took place across Spain, with protesters camping at Puerta del Sol following the rejection of government housing decrees in Congress.

stories.title: Protección Civil restringe la movilidad y suspende actividades al aire libre ante el fuerte temporal y la alerta de un "mini huracán" en el litoral de Cataluña

en.title: Civil Protection restricts mobility and suspends outdoor activities amid severe storm and mini-hurricane alert in Catalonia coast
en.summary: Authorities restricted movement and halted outdoor activities in Catalonia as a severe weather system approached, with red alert warnings expected for twenty counties due to dangerous conditions.

stories.title: Las manifestaciones por la vivienda recorren todo el país con llamadas a la huelga general

en.title: Housing protests across the country call for general strike
en.summary: Housing activists announced plans for a general strike in response to the country's housing crisis, stating the movement will accelerate regardless of electoral outcomes.

stories.title: Five Guys acelera sus aperturas en España con ocho locales al año

en.title: Five Guys accelerates its openings in Spain with eight locations per year
en.summary: Five Guys plans to reach 50 stores in Spain by 2027, with double-digit growth expected this year.

stories.title: ¿Quién manda en los escúteres de rueda alta?

en.title: Who dominates the large-wheel scooter market?
en.summary: Large-wheel scooters became prevalent in Spain starting with Honda Scoopy's 16-inch wheel design, offering better stability on urban terrain before the market shifted toward smaller 13 and 14-inch wheel models.

stories.title: La Caixa blinda su poder en el consejo de Naturgy

en.title: La Caixa strengthens its power on Naturgy's board
en.summary: Naturgy announced key changes to its board voting system through official regulatory filings.

stories.title: Iberdrola y Telefónica, contra el decreto de centros de datos

en.title: Iberdrola and Telefónica oppose the data centers decree
en.summary: Iberdrola's CEO in Spain argued against demonizing data centers, opposing a government decree affecting their development.
